# harsh's space (harshgupta.me)

> the personal site of harsh gupta, a full-stack developer (php, wordpress, react, python) from chhattisgarh, india. one sentence, an interactive ringed planet made of ascii characters, a guestbook, and an occasional long post.

## pages

- https://harshgupta.me/ — the sentence: projects from github, recent writing, what's playing, and how to say hi
- https://harshgupta.me/blog — writing. infrequent, long.
- https://harshgupta.me/blog/simple-over-clever — "simple > clever, a year of commits": a read-back of a year on github
